title: "Immune Classifier, Step 4: SMOTE Balancing of Rare Cell Types"
author: "Meite I, Pesce L, Feinstein M, Thorp EB, Lantz C"
date: "2026-03-06"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Phase 4: SMOTE Balancing
# Cardiac Immune Classifier
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(yaml)
})


# Load config
config_path <- "config/config.yaml"
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)

set.seed(config$splitting$random_seed)


#Load Atlas with Splits
cat("\n[1/7] Loading atlas with splits...\n")

atlas_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_with_splits.rds")
if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) {
  stop("Atlas with splits not found. Run Phase 3 first: ", atlas_path)
}

seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

cat(sprintf("Loaded atlas with %s cells\n",
            format(ncol(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ",")))

#Extract Training Set
cat("\n[2/7] Extracting training set...\n")

train_cells <- colnames(seurat_atlas)[seurat_atlas$split == "train"]
train_atlas <- seurat_atlas[, train_cells]

cat(sprintf("Training set: %s cells across %d cell types\n",
            format(ncol(train_atlas), big.mark = ","),
            length(unique(train_atlas$cell_type))))

#Identify Rare Cell Types
cat("\n[3/7] Identifying rare cell types...\n")

# Get cell type counts in training set
train_counts <- table(train_atlas$cell_type)
total_train <- ncol(train_atlas)

# Calculate percentages
train_pct <- (train_counts / total_train) * 100

# Define rare threshold from config
rare_threshold <- config$smote$rare_threshold_pct

# Identify rare and common types
rare_types <- names(train_pct[train_pct < rare_threshold])
common_types <- names(train_pct[train_pct >= rare_threshold])

cat(sprintf("  Rare threshold: <%.0f%% of training set\n", rare_threshold))
cat(sprintf("  Rare cell types: %d\n", length(rare_types)))
cat(sprintf("  Common cell types: %d\n\n", length(common_types)))

# Summary table
type_summary <- data.frame(
  Cell_Type = names(train_counts),
  Count = as.numeric(train_counts),
  Percentage = as.numeric(train_pct),
  Category = ifelse(names(train_counts) %in% rare_types, "Rare", "Common")
) %>% arrange(desc(Count))


#SMOTE Function
cat("\n[4/7] Defining SMOTE function...\n")

apply_smote <- function(seurat_obj, ratio_name = "1:3", rare_threshold_pct = 5) {

  # Extract PCA coordinates (50 PCs)
  pca_coords <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, reduction = "pca")[, 1:50]
  labels <- seurat_obj$cell_type
  
  # Identify rare vs common
  type_counts <- table(labels)
  total_cells <- length(labels)
  type_pct <- (type_counts / total_cells) * 100
  rare_types <- names(type_pct[type_pct < rare_threshold_pct])
  common_types <- names(type_pct[type_pct >= rare_threshold_pct])
  
  if (length(rare_types) == 0) {
    seurat_obj$synthetic <- FALSE
    return(seurat_obj)
  }
  
  # Parse ratio
  ratio_parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_name, ":")[[1]])
  rare_multiplier <- ratio_parts[1]
  common_multiplier <- ratio_parts[2]
  
  # Calculate target for rare types
  if (length(common_types) > 0) {
    max_common_count <- max(type_counts[common_types])
  } else {
    max_common_count <- max(type_counts)
  }
  target_rare_count <- ceiling(max_common_count * (rare_multiplier / common_multiplier))
  
  # Generate synthetic cells for each rare type
  all_synthetic_pca <- list()
  all_synthetic_labels <- c()
  
  for (rare_type in rare_types) {
    current_count <- type_counts[rare_type]
    needed <- target_rare_count - current_count
    
    if (needed <= 0) {
      cat(sprintf("    %s: Already sufficient (%d cells)\n", rare_type, current_count))
      next
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("    %s: Need %d synthetic cells (current: %d)\n",
                rare_type, needed, current_count))
    
    rare_indices <- which(labels == rare_type)
    rare_pca <- pca_coords[rare_indices, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Determine k for kNN 
    k_neighbors <- min(5, nrow(rare_pca) - 1)
    
    if (k_neighbors < 1) {
      cat(sprintf("    %s: Too few cells (%d), skipping\n", rare_type, nrow(rare_pca)))
      next
    }
    
    synthetic_samples <- matrix(NA, nrow = needed, ncol = 50)
    
    for (i in 1:needed) {
      # Randomly select a real cell
      anchor_idx <- sample(1:nrow(rare_pca), 1)
      anchor_cell <- rare_pca[anchor_idx, ]
      
      # Find k nearest neighbors
      distances <- apply(rare_pca, 1, function(x) sqrt(sum((x - anchor_cell)^2)))
      neighbor_indices <- order(distances)[2:(k_neighbors + 1)]  # exclude self
      
      # Randomly pick one neighbor
      neighbor_idx <- sample(neighbor_indices, 1)
      neighbor_cell <- rare_pca[neighbor_idx, ]
      
      # Interpolate between anchor and neighbor
      lambda <- runif(1)  # random weight between 0 and 1
      synthetic_cell <- anchor_cell + lambda * (neighbor_cell - anchor_cell)
      
      synthetic_samples[i, ] <- synthetic_cell
    }
    
    colnames(synthetic_samples) <- colnames(pca_coords)
    
    all_synthetic_pca[[rare_type]] <- synthetic_samples
    all_synthetic_labels <- c(all_synthetic_labels, rep(rare_type, needed))
    
    cat(sprintf("    %s: ✓ Generated %d synthetic cells\n", rare_type, needed))
  }
  
  # Combine all synthetic data
  if (length(all_synthetic_pca) == 0) {
    cat("    No synthetic cells generated\n")
    seurat_obj$synthetic <- FALSE
    return(seurat_obj)
  }
  
  all_synthetic_pca_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_synthetic_pca)
  n_synthetic <- nrow(all_synthetic_pca_combined)
  
  # Create synthetic cell IDs and metadata
  synthetic_ids <- paste0("synthetic_", gsub(":", "_", ratio_name), "_", 1:n_synthetic)
  rownames(all_synthetic_pca_combined) <- synthetic_ids
  
  # Combine original and synthetic PCA embeddings
  original_pca <- pca_coords
  combined_pca <- rbind(original_pca, all_synthetic_pca_combined)
  
  # Create metadata for synthetic cells
  synthetic_meta <- data.frame(
    cell_type = all_synthetic_labels,
    cell_id = synthetic_ids,
    source = "synthetic",
    split = "train",
    synthetic = TRUE,
    row.names = synthetic_ids,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Mark original cells
  seurat_obj$synthetic <- FALSE
  
  
  # Get original counts
  counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = DefaultAssay(seurat_obj), layer = "counts")  
  synthetic_counts <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(counts), ncol = n_synthetic, sparse = TRUE)
  colnames(synthetic_counts) <- synthetic_ids
  rownames(synthetic_counts) <- rownames(counts)
  
  # Combine counts
  combined_counts <- cbind(counts, synthetic_counts)
  
  # Create new Seurat object
  seurat_combined <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = combined_counts,
    meta.data = rbind(
      seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("cell_type", "cell_id", "source", "split", "synthetic")],
      synthetic_meta
    )
  )
  
  # Add PCA reduction
  seurat_combined[["pca"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = combined_pca,
    key = "PC_",
    assay = DefaultAssay(seurat_combined)
  )
  
  return(seurat_combined)
}

cat("SMOTE function defined\n")

#Apply SMOTE with Different Ratios
cat("\n[5/7] Applying SMOTE with different ratios...\n\n")

ratios_to_test <- config$smote$ratios_to_test
balanced_datasets <- list()

for (ratio in ratios_to_test) {
  balanced_datasets[[ratio]] <- apply_smote(
    seurat_obj = train_atlas,
    ratio_name = ratio,
    rare_threshold_pct = rare_threshold
  )
  
  cat("\n")
}


#Validate Synthetic Cells
cat("\n[6/7] Validating synthetic cells (PCA overlay)...\n")

results_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "figures", "phase4_smote")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ratio in ratios_to_test) {
  dataset <- balanced_datasets[[ratio]]
  
  if (sum(dataset$synthetic) > 0) {
    
    # PCA plot showing real vs synthetic
    p_validation <- DimPlot(
      dataset,
      reduction = "pca",
      group.by = "synthetic",
      dims = c(1, 2)
    ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("FALSE" = "#2E7D32", "TRUE" = "#E53935"),
        labels = c("FALSE" = "Real", "TRUE" = "Synthetic")
      ) +
      ggtitle(paste0("SMOTE Validation: ", ratio, " ratio")) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0("smote_validation_", gsub(":", "_", ratio), ".png")),
      plot = p_validation,
      width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}


#Save Balanced Datasets
cat("\n[7/7] Saving balanced datasets...\n")

processed_dir <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "smote_balanced")
dir.create(processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ratio in ratios_to_test) {
  ratio_clean <- gsub(":", "_", ratio)
  output_path <- file.path(processed_dir, paste0("train_smote_", ratio_clean, ".rds"))
  
  saveRDS(balanced_datasets[[ratio]], output_path)
  
  cat(sprintf("Saved %s: %s\n", ratio, output_path))
}

# Summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Ratio = character(),
  Original_Cells = integer(),
  Synthetic_Cells = integer(),
  Total_Cells = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (ratio in ratios_to_test) {
  dataset <- balanced_datasets[[ratio]]
  summary_stats <- rbind(summary_stats, data.frame(
    Ratio = ratio,
    Original_Cells = sum(!dataset$synthetic),
    Synthetic_Cells = sum(dataset$synthetic),
    Total_Cells = ncol(dataset)
  ))
}

metrics_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "metrics")
write.csv(
  summary_stats,
  file = file.path(metrics_dir, "phase4_smote_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(sprintf("Saved summary to: %s\n",
            file.path(metrics_dir, "phase4_smote_summary.csv")))


cat("Phase 4 Complete: SMOTE Balancing\n")

cat(sprintf("Rare cell types identified: %d (<%d%% of training)\n",
            length(rare_types), rare_threshold))
cat(sprintf("SMOTE ratios tested: %s\n", paste(ratios_to_test, collapse = ", ")))
print(summary_stats, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nNext step:\n")
cat("Run Phase 5: Hyperparameter Tuning (src/05_hyperparameter_tuning.R)\n\n")

```
